# External TransLasso implementation

Simulations 4--5 and the ADME comparison require the official
`TransLasso-functions.R` file from:

<https://github.com/saili0103/TransLasso>

The manuscript analyses used repository commit
`285009edf3e638567474108f823adcc1dc6c7c4a`. Obtain the file locally with:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/saili0103/TransLasso.git
git -C TransLasso checkout 285009edf3e638567474108f823adcc1dc6c7c4a
```

Pass the absolute path to `TransLasso-functions.R` to the simulation and
real-data runners. The file is not redistributed here because the upstream
repository does not display an explicit software license.
